title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Act on Management of Firefighting Equipment [Attached Table 4] <Amended on May 15, 2023>

Detailed Criteria for Revocation of Designation or Suspension of Services of Centers and Business Establishments (Re: Article 42)

1. General criteria

(a) Where there are two or more violations and the respective disposition criteria differ, the heavier disposition criteria shall apply.

(b) Administrative disposition criteria according to the number of violations shall apply where an administrative disposition has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding year. The period shall be calculated by reference to the date on which the administrative disposition was imposed for the violation and the date on which the same violation committed again after that disposition was detected.

(c) Where an aggravated administrative disposition is imposed under item (b), the occurrence level applied for the aggravated disposition shall be the level immediately following the occurrence level of the administrative disposition imposed before the violation (where two or more administrative dispositions were imposed within the period under item (b), the highest such occurrence level).

(d) The disposition authority may mitigate revocation of designation or suspension of services under paragraph 2 (b) or (c) to a corrective order in consideration of the following circumstances:

1) Where the violation is found to have resulted from minor carelessness or a simple error, rather than intent or gross negligence;

2) Where the substance and degree of the violation are minor and it is deemed capable of immediate correction.

2. Individual criteria

| Violation | Legal basis | First violation | Second violation | Third violation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (a) Obtaining designation by fraud or other improper means | Article 36 (4) 1 of the Act | Revocation of designation | | |
| (b) Failing to perform the services for a continuous period of six months or longer without good cause | Article 36 (4) 2 of the Act | Corrective order | Revocation of designation | |
| (c) Ceasing to meet the requirements for designation under Article 36 (1) or (3) of the Act | Article 36 (4) 3 of the Act | Corrective order | Suspension of services for three months | Revocation of designation |
